grid: 3 radii x 8 angles, mass free in [7.5, 11.5]

controls.polish: smooth fit continued from its solution with max_nfev 24*40*(n_par+1)
controls.macro_basin: every cell's joint macro solution, perturber removed, macro params re-optimised (max_nfev 40*(n_par+1)); delta_chi2 is measured against the best smooth chi2 over all starts

merged_from: intact records of a run corrupted by a concurrent regate + the rest re-run with --skip-indices (same seeds)
